targets.rawSql:
SELECT "Field", "Value" FROM (
  SELECT 'Timestamp' AS "Field", event_timestamp::text AS "Value", 1 AS ord FROM events WHERE id::text = '$event_id'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Event Type', event_type, 2 FROM events WHERE id::text = '$event_id'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Skill', skill_name, 3 FROM events WHERE id::text = '$event_id'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Ticket', coalesce(ticket_id,'-'), 4 FROM events WHERE id::text = '$event_id'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Correlation ID', correlation_id, 5 FROM events WHERE id::text = '$event_id'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Repository', repository, 6 FROM events WHERE id::text = '$event_id'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Branch', coalesce(branch,'-'), 7 FROM events WHERE id::text = '$event_id'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Event ID', id::text, 8 FROM events WHERE id::text = '$event_id'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Received At', received_at::text, 9 FROM events WHERE id::text = '$event_id'
  UNION ALL SELECT kv.key, (CASE jsonb_typeof(kv.value) WHEN 'array' THEN jsonb_pretty(kv.value) WHEN 'object' THEN jsonb_pretty(kv.value) ELSE trim(both '"' from kv.value::text) END), 100 + kv.n
    FROM events, jsonb_each(metadata) WITH ORDINALITY AS kv(key, value, n)
    WHERE events.id::text = '$event_id'
) t ORDER BY ord
